meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides the Podnews newsletter hero, testimonials, supporter logo wall and network footer; blur or hide story pictures.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on podnews.net/. The phone page is the same server-rendered markup; an iPhone-UA capture was not obtained (Chrome and the network were out of memory on this machine at the time), so real.html is absent and the rules are proven on desktop-real.html only. Article pages (/update/...) were not captured.

LIVE counts on Home: newsletter-hero desktop home 1; testimonials desktop home 1; supporter-wall desktop home 1; pictures-blur desktop home 12; pictures-hide desktop home 12; network-footer desktop home 1. Selectors use ids and stable class names (subscribe, belowfold, sponsor, testimonials, latest).

Choice: Story pictures Show/Blur/Hide (blur 10px). `main > article picture` also catches the newsletter hero picture; `#latest picture` is the story list.

NOT verified: article pages and their in-article sponsor reads, the jobs and events pages, a phone capture, other locales. The 1.0.0 generic cookie, ad and app rules match nothing live.
